info.title: LuxMap API
info.description: WP2 — GIS + IoT + Computer Vision platform for rural street-lighting assets. Base URL /api/v1. Conventions from API Contract v1.1: snake_case JSON, lowercase string enums, ISO 8601 UTC timestamps with a Z suffix, EPSG:4326 coordinates.
